title: Cover
description: AForce — the performance operating system. Performance is non-negotiable. Pause. Hydrate. Lock in. Perform. This is beyond a hydration brand — it is a performance standard.

title: Founder Proof
description: Built where performance is required. Brandon and Julius have operated where performance is expected, pressure is constant, and failure has consequences. NBA: no off nights. Wall Street: no missed moments. Entrepreneurship: no second chances. What defines them is not perfection — it is consistency. AForce takes sports discipline, repetition, and consistency under pressure and translates it into modern professional performance.

title: Mission
description: Performance is non-negotiable. The Brand Truth: not your best ever, not your best in perfect conditions — your best, reliably, consistently, every single day. Plus the Human Insight and the Category Claim. The daily ritual: Morning, Midday, Pre-performance, Recovery. Voiced by founders Brandon & Julius Burrell.

title: Problem
description: The Disruption. The energy category is loud by design (Red Bull, Monster, Celsius) — every other brand shows up after performance breaks down. AForce does something fundamentally different: it removes noise, removes friction, creates clarity, and prepares you for performance.

title: Timing
description: National attention at the moment of launch. Summer 2026 launch → Fall 2026 filming → Spring 2027 national broadcast. Visibility meets availability. Demand meets supply.

title: Product
description: One system. Three flavors. Two formats. One outcome — sustained performance. Stability, recovery, output under pressure. This is not hydration. This is performance fuel.

title: AForce OS
description: The intelligence layer. Product fuels the body. AForce OS tells you what to do next. Three steps: Score (reads your state), Command (tells you what to do), Improve (learns over time). No wearable required. Starts simple. Gets smarter over time.

title: AForce OS · Tech Proof
description: Not a vision — a system already running. AForce OS app live in TestFlight, closed-loop algorithm v1 functional, performance scoring model deployed, USPTO patent filed (App 64/057,695). Roadmap: AI Coach v1 (Q4 2026, $800K from this raise) · Clutch (2027) · Guardian (2027+) · Phantom (Phase 2+, $0 from this raise). 5,000+ engineering hours · TestFlight live · patent filed.

title: Product Tour
description: One system. Multiple states. Performance Score, Social Mode, Recovery Mode — the OS adapts to every state of the body.

title: OS Roadmap
description: Building the performance layer. AI Coach (2026, consumer) → Clutch (2027, team SaaS) → Guardian (2027, enterprise + medical). $216B+ TAM, $48B SAM, $1.4B SOM.

title: At Scale
description: Performance at scale. Clutch puts the coach in command of game-day roster tiers; Guardian gives medical and enterprise teams composite risk + critical alerts on the same loop. Individual to team to system.

title: Market
description: The performance economy. AForce sits at the intersection of product, behavior, and data — functional beverages, sports drinks, and stick mixes all converging.

title: Competitors
description: No competitor operates a system. AForce vs. Liquid IV, LMNT, BodyArmor, Gatorade, Prime — the category has drinks. AForce has a loop.

title: Competitive Advantage
description: System is the moat. CPG is copied. Systems compound. Others sell products. AForce builds performance infrastructure.

title: Go-To-Market
description: Build. Scale. Lead. Six phases from DTC launch to global category leader. We don't sell hydration — we install a daily performance system. Hardware scales. Software compounds. The OS creates retention.

title: Traction
description: Momentum before launch. $832K closed, 179 launch creators, 2.3M+ watching before product is on shelf, America's Real Deal Season 2 national TV premiere. Product ready. System ready. Demand building.

title: Unit Economics
description: Bottoms-up model: 40/25/20/15 product mix, $52×5–7×/65%=$383 CLTV ÷ $49 CAC = 5:1 LTV:CAC. Benchmarked vs Liquid I.V./LMNT. SaaS layer modeled as upside.

title: Path to $3.2M
description: Growth driven by repeat behavior. 60,000 orders × $52 AOV = $3.2M. Five-stage acquisition→retention engine. Performance creates retention. Retention drives revenue.

title: Financial Projections
description: Scaling a performance system. $3.2M (2026) → $13M (2027) → $27.8M (2028). EBITDA breakeven late 2027. The product creates entry. The system creates compounding value.

title: Team
description: Brandon Burrell, Julius Burrell — with advisors Mark Mendel, Adam Sobol, Thomas Masterbouni, and Chief Scientist Mark Satterfield.

title: Funding & Use of Funds
description: $4M Series Seed Preferred. Q1 2026 close. 40/20/20/10/10 allocation across inventory, GTM, OS, distribution, team.

title: The Ask
description: Performance is non-negotiable. AForce makes sure you're always on. Where there are no off days. No missed moments. We're raising $4M to own the performance standard — scale product to meet demand, launch AForce OS + subscription layer, expand retail + direct channels, build the performance brand. The edge is control.
